newsitem.title: BELGIUM: French AXA to bid for, delist AXA Belgium.
newsitem.headline: French AXA to bid for, delist AXA Belgium.

text.p: French insurance group AXA SA said on Monday it will make a public bid in the form of a share swap for the 5.23 percent of AXA Belgium SA it does not already own.

In a statement, AXA said it will offer three of its shares for every two held in AXA Belgium. AXA said the shares to be offered are presently held as treasury stock and are equal to 0.28 percent of AXA's total issued capital.
Ahead of the news, AXA shares closed in Paris up 1.7 at 313.2 French francs. AXA Belgium was down 30 at 1,870 Belgian francs.
A spokeswoman for AXA in Paris told Reuters that if the offer was successful, AXA Belgium would be delisted from the Brussels Stock Exchange and would not be replaced by AXA's own shares.
The decision ends months of speculation about the future of AXA Belgium's listing, which remains the group's only listing outside Paris and New York.

AXA Belgium said earlier this year that its listing was under review and a share swap could be one of the options. The statement helped raise AXA Belgium's share price to around 1,800 from around 1,500 francs.
AXA said its share swap would probably take place at the beginning of November once its prospectus had been approved by Belgium's bourse regulator, the Banking and Finance Commission.
